recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-14522 unless a future work-group decision revisits the supportedProfile/resource-type explanation more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-14522 was a Published FHIR-core/fhir-i STU3 clarification with resolution Persuasive with Modification. additional_context: The combined branch source/profiling.html:165 still contains the resolved sentence. Searches for FHIR-14522 and the affected phrase found only the Jira record and a Zulip tracker bot notification, with no Confluence or substantive Zulip discussion indicating a later conflicting decision. Nearby typo issues found in the same search path are separate and already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active profiling page already matches the Jira resolution and no source edit is necessary.
